policies.title: German ordinary passports: Niger advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Niger's current official guidance requires ordinary German-passport holders to file an entry-visa application with a Niger mission before short visitor travel.
conditions: The live Niger Embassy notice expressly names ordinary German-passport holders and directs them to lodge visa applications at Niger missions in Geneva, Ankara or Moscow.
Niger's Foreign Ministry states that normal filing is at a mission from the applicant's residence and gives a 15-day issuance time.

A border visa is exceptional, requires Interior Ministry authorisation, and is limited to departure from a country without a Niger diplomatic or consular mission; it is not the normal visitor baseline.
Diplomatic, service, transit, bilateral or community-exempt, residence, work and final-admission treatment are outside this classification.

policies.title: German ordinary passports: Sierra Leone border-issued visitor eVisa
policies.summary: German ordinary-passport visitors must obtain Sierra Leone's online approval before travel; the visa itself is issued on arrival at the border.
conditions: Apply and pay online sufficiently before travel; the German Federal Foreign Office says issuance follows at arrival at the border after approval.
This is normalized as visa_on_arrival because the visa is issued at the border, despite the mandatory online pre-application.
Passport validity, yellow-fever documentation, health declaration, extension, work, residence, special documents and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Sierra Leone Immigration eVisa service
steps: Apply and pay online before departure using the German ordinary passport to be used for travel.
After approval, present the required documents at the border for visa issuance.

unresolved.reason: The current German Foreign Office page expressly limits its entry information to pre-August-2021 rules it believes remain applied. Current Afghan sources establish generic or conditional routes but not a working German ordinary-passport visitor issuance channel, so visa_required is not promoted.
